Privacy Policy

Last updated 19 August 2026

This policy covers tinytools.studio, the marketing site for Tiny Tools Studio LLC. Our individual products — Don’t Forget Club and Get Flexy — have their own policies, listed where you download or sign up for them.

What we collect

Only what you type into the contact form on this site: your name, your email address, and your message. Nothing else. There is no analytics script, no advertising pixel, and no third-party tracker on this page.

Cookies

This site sets no cookies.

Why we collect it

So we can read your message and reply to it. We do not add you to a mailing list, and we do not sell, rent, or share your details with anyone.

Where it goes

Contact form submissions are stored by our site host and are readable only by us. The site is served through Cloudflare, which processes standard request logs on our behalf as part of delivering and protecting the site.

How long we keep it

We keep correspondence for as long as it is useful to us, and delete it on request.

Your choices

Email hello@tinytools.studio and ask us for a copy of what we hold about you, a correction, or a deletion. We will do it.

Changes

If this policy changes we will update the date at the top of this page.
